# Sea Glass

Sea Glass is a dark-only, beach-inspired theme with soft sea-glass colours and VSCode-style syntax highlighting. It uses Euclid Circular A for the UI and editor and CaskaydiaCove Nerd Font Mono for code blocks, falling back to other fonts when those are not installed.

![Sea Glass screenshot](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/kstew1017/obsidian-sea-glass-theme/HEAD/sea-glass-preview.png)

```cue
theme: {
    name:   "Sea Glass"
    author: "kstew1017"
    repo:   "kstew1017/obsidian-sea-glass-theme"
    slug:   "sea-glass"

    html_url:       "https://community.obsidian.md/themes/sea-glass"
    github_url:     "https://github.com/kstew1017/obsidian-sea-glass-theme"
    screenshot_url: "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/kstew1017/obsidian-sea-glass-theme/HEAD/sea-glass-preview.png"

    modes: ["dark"]
    about: "Apply a beach-inspired dark-only theme with soft sea-glass colors and VSCode-style syntax highlighting. Use Euclid Circular A for UI/editor and CaskaydiaCove Nerd Font Mono for code blocks, with fallbacks if fonts aren't installed."
}
```
